name: The Demon You Don't V1
author: The Last Eseption
bootlegger: The Demon picks who they play. The Demon may change into any other Demon. If so, They do not kill tonight. (They can not change into a Demon they have already been).
If any Character learns the Demon or Demon Player. The Demon is stuck as the Demon they currently are until the game is over.
The Minion and Demon do not know each other. In the case of a Kazali, they may choose which Minion(s) but not which Player(s).
If the Hatter died not by Execution, the Demon is stuck as the Demon they currently are until the game is over. And the Minion(s) is Drunk until Dusk.
The Politician may start as either Evil or Good, Each night, They learn how many Evil and Good characters are in play.
The Grandmother does not learn the good Players Character.
